limitations: This is fresh actual-main qualification of the merged endpoint-inspector source slice and preserved package/runtime gates. It does not authorize or prove production deployment.

Endpoint verification covers 81 source and installed cases with owned loopback TLS fixtures, bounded protocol checks and conservative cleanup. No external endpoint, stored real credential, OAuth login, endpoint routing, authenticated readiness or live enrollment was exercised.

The separate immutable source review retains earlier local full source/package gate failures caused by Unix-socket listen EPERM; those local outcomes remain failed. Fresh candidate and actual-main hosted jobs passed on the identical published source tree.
The capability register remains an explicitly dated snapshot; no whole-requirement completion is awarded on any of its five axes.
Four real Codex registration/configuration/shutdown lanes and SDK calls to the configured command passed. No actual Codex agent tool invocation or model call occurred.

Five production-package license files and bounded provenance checks passed. Full transitive license clearance, full runtime-image redistribution eligibility and full Desktop Commander parity remain false.

Native Linux evidence covers 12 real source and 12 real installed scenarios, all 24 cleanup receipts and 16 OOM probes, plus 31 separate synthetic protocol cases. A separate native-review agent independently checked the fresh actual-main ZIP and pinned public-key signature.

Native bootstrap package payloads, installed runtime binaries and OCI layers are not present in the retained artifact. Those on-runner checks are bounded by the source-bound harness and retained reports; this is not complete isolation acceptance.
